with latest as ( select r.* from topic_route_session r where r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.id = (select max(x.id) from topic_route_session x where x.member_id = r.member_id and x.activity_id = r.activity_id and x.topic_id = r.topic_id) ), facts as ( select r.member_id as memberId, r.id as sessionId, case when r.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end as reachedEnding, coalesce((select sum(l.delta_centi) from orient_score_ledger l where l.session_id = r.id), 0) as scoreCenti, case when r.status in (1,2) then case when c.session_id is not null then case when c.ended_at is not null and c.elapsed_ms >= 0 then c.elapsed_ms end when r.completed_at is not null and r.create_time is not null and r.completed_at >= r.create_time then timestampdiff(MICROSECOND,r.create_time,r.completed_at) div 1000 end end as elapsedMs from latest r left join orient_session_clock c on c.session_id = r.id and c.member_id = r.member_id ), ranked as ( select facts.*, rank() over (order by
reachedEnding desc, scoreCenti desc,
elapsedMs is null asc, elapsedMs asc) as boardRank from facts ), numbered as ( select ranked.*, row_number() over (order by boardRank,memberId) as displayRow from ranked ) select memberId,sessionId,reachedEnding,scoreCenti,elapsedMs,boardRank,displayRow from numbered where displayRow <= #{limit} or memberId = #{memberId} order by displayRow
